annotations.title: UAE QFZP De-Minimis & EU GDPR Trigger Gate

description: Check UAE Corporate Tax QFZP 0% de-minimis cliff (Federal Decree-Law 47/2022 & MD 265/2023) and EU GDPR Art. 3/30/35 triggers. Read-only diagnostic gate; zero tax liability math.

eu_data_subjects.description: Whether organization processes personal data of individuals in the EU/EEA under GDPR Article 3.

excluded_activity.description: Whether entity performs an excluded activity under UAE Ministerial Decision No. 265 of 2023.

high_risk_processing.description: Whether processing involves large-scale profiling, special categories, or systematic monitoring triggering GDPR Art. 35 DPIA.

non_qualifying_aed.description: Annual non-qualifying revenue in UAE Dirhams (AED; checked against AED 5,000,000 de-minimis ceiling).

non_qualifying_pct.description: Percentage share of non-qualifying revenue out of total Free Zone revenue (0 to 100; 5% statutory cliff).

query_note.description: Optional non-sensitive context note for diagnostic scope triage.

regime.description: Statutory compliance regime to evaluate: 'uae_qfzp', 'gdpr', or 'both'.
